scope: Source-level evidence that, for one full run segment using the same locked candidate binary/toolchain, initial SvrState/ensemble seed, N, dt and step count, the same root-owned pseudorandom draw stream is consumed at P1/P2/P4. This establishes call-stream alignment, not bitwise equality of resulting thermo, scale factors, positions or trajectories; no per-step RNG trace was captured.

source_files.symbols: M1 run_segment controller ownership and seed; step loop; M1 replicated runtime; segment dispatch

findings.seed_consistency: Before runtime, stochastic ensemble commands compare the exact DMGMD_ENSEMBLE_SEED string across ranks and validate its uint32 syntax (runtime_internal.hpp:154-170). The registered decimal seed is common across ranks; run_segment constructs one EnsembleController on root with that seed and creates SvrState there (runtime.cu:705-710; ensemble_control.cpp:98-106). For this 216-atom fixture ndeg=3N=648, so resamplekin_sumnoises receives fixed ndeg-1=647 on every rank-count/backend condition. Non-root ranks do not own or advance SCR RNG.
findings.per_step_order: For each fixed-dt NPT step, the M1 replicated runtime computes globally reduced thermo, invokes root-owned after_force() for the BDP kinetic resampling, broadcasts its validated velocity factor, applies velocity scaling, then invokes root-owned ensemble_box_factor()/barostat_scale() and broadcasts the checked box factor. Thus the shared RNG order is BDP draws followed by the pressure Gaussian draw once per step.
findings.draw_count_independence: resamplekin() always draws one gasdev value then calls resamplekin_sumnoises(ndeg-1). ndeg is fixed by the common atom count. Its branch is based only on ndeg parity/value; gamma rejection loops depend on RNG values, not kk/velocity/thermo. With same RNG state and binary, rejection decisions and draw counts therefore match. Pressure barostat_scale() calls gasdev exactly once per NPT SCR step even when pressure coupling is zero (B>2000 fixed-box path). gasdev's cached paired variate is part of the same root SvrState.
findings.rank_backend_independence: Rank count/backend changes force/reduction roundoff and can alter thermo state and resulting factors. It does not change root-only BDP/SCR call sites, ndeg, fixed step loop, or random draw schedule. With identical starting SvrState and same binary/toolchain, gasdev/gamdev take the same RNG-driven rejection decisions and consume the same pseudorandom stream. The audit is source-level (no per-step RNG trace), and does not claim equal factor values, thermo, positions, or trajectories across rank/backend.
findings.m1_only: M2a local-domain execution explicitly rejects NPT before entering its dynamics loop. The relevant comparison is P1/P2/P4 through the replicated M1 runtime, not an M2a NPT loop.
findings.run_boundary: A fresh controller/RNG is constructed per run segment. This confirmation registers one single full-budget run per seed/profile/condition, so no cross-segment RNG-continuation assumption is used.

limits: Requires candidate binary SHA, source digest, inputs and ensemble_seed to match the registration.
Any source or candidate binary change, or failure of the specified MPI rank seed-consistency/rng_draw_evidence checks, invalidates bridge eligibility.

The same-stream conclusion assumes the locked candidate binary/toolchain and initial SvrState. Rank/backend floating-point reductions may change trajectory values, but source control flow does not branch RNG consumption on those values. No per-step RNG trace was captured.
